new_fabdem.product: FABDEM V1-2 (Forests and Buildings removed Copernicus DEM)

difference_analysis.building_canopy_contamination: Skadi DEM is an uncorrected radar DSM; reflections from multi-story commercial buildings on Church Street cause positive elevation spikes up to +16.6 m above the true ground.
difference_analysis.vertical_datum_offset: EGM96 versus EGM2008 geoid undulation difference over Bengaluru accounts for approximately 0.1 to 0.3 m of the difference.
difference_analysis.variance_reduction: Standard deviation drops from 5.61 m in Skadi to 1.38 m in FABDEM, proving that the true urban terrain surface is smooth and continuous.
difference_analysis.curb_and_sidewalk_suitability: Neither raster resolves sub-metre curb geometry, transverse 2% drainage slopes, or building foundation thresholds.

cautious_classification.role: regional terrain reference and provisional elevation baseline
